sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at the office. Going to debrief with Night Shift and then gear up to go and patrol.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. Whilst patrolling we will be conducting welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks and Queen St McDonald's are all clear. Localito and 77 convenience stores have just opened. Continuing to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a sweep of the area.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's asking for assistance with removing vagrants. Also Aotea Square is all clear.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's and removed 2 males and 3 juveniles (video provided). Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on the Commercial Bay area.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen St asking for assistance with removing a vagrant sleeping in their business; heading to them now.
We arrived and removed the male POI from Queen St McDonald's with no issues (video provided). Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards top of Victoria St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St; welfare checks completed (standing by for security presence):
Heading towards Elliot St via Federal and Wellesley St.
Federal and Wellesley St is all clear. Commencing patrol sweep of Elliot and Darby St.
Elliot and Darby St is all clear. Heading towards The Library; we will be conducting welfare checks on the businesses heading towards the Library.
The Library is all clear. Heading towards Shortland St via Lorne and High St.
Lorne St and High St is all clear. On Shortland heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell St.
O'Connell St, Freyberg Square, and Chancery Square is all clear. Standing by for security presence and seeking shelter.
Welfare checks completed at the following (heading to check on Gore St):
Welfare checks completed at the following (standing by for security presence and seeking shelter):
Heading towards Britomart via Custom St.
Welfare checks completed at the following (heading to check in on Britomart McDonald's):
All clear at McDonald's Britomart. Checking on Commercial Bay.
Received a call from Coffee Club Victoria St in regards to a male vagrant refusing to leave the premises; heading to the location now via Albert St.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing towards Coffee Club.

Arrived at Coffee Club. The worker stated to us that the POI has been given food and is not an issue; they do not wish to make or cause a scene with customers present. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Localito in regards to a vagrant being aggressive towards him; heading to assist.

We arrived at the scene to 2 female Council Compliance Wardens having a verbal confrontation with the POI. We stood between the 2 parties to ensure the safety of the Wardens and store worker. After the exchanges the POI vacated with his belongings and we grabbed the statement of the store worker. He stated that he approached the male — who at the time was with a female vagrant and 2 dogs — and kindly asked them to leave because their presence is disorderly and disrupting his business. The male POI became aggressive towards him, and that's when the Wardens witnessed the situation and approached to de-escalate. Sadly the situation became heated (video provided). Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks completed at the following (continuing towards Aotea Square):
Welfare checks completed at the following (commencing sweep in Aotea Square):
All clear in Aotea Square. Standing by for security presence and seeking shelter from rain.
Heading towards Victoria St via Meyers St, Mayoral Drive and Albert St.
Arrived at corner of Victoria and Albert St. Heading down towards Queen St.
Welfare checks completed at the following (standing by for security presence):
Heading towards Britomart via Queen St.
Welfare checks from Mecca and Farmers down till OPSM and Hallensteins. All clear, no issues. Checking on Chemist Warehouse.
Chemist Warehouse all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Stores from Kathmandu till Q convenience store is all clear. Heading to check on Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's is all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to HQ via Gore, Fort, and High St.
Received a call about a vagrant sleeping in the BNZ building; heading to the location now.
We arrived on site and tried calling the person. She then said that the Wardens removed him. Heading to HQ to have break.
Standing by at the office for shift handover.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:45 – 22:30)
items: Debrief with morning shift complete. Commencing welfare checks heading to Chancery Square.
Note: due to weather conditions patrols will be limited to sheltered areas but will complete routes.
First half of High St and Freyberg Square complete; no issues to report. Coming up on Chancery Square.
Chancery Square check clear; no issues to report.
2nd half of High St complete; no issues. Vulcan Lane clear. Heading to Fort St.
Shortland Street walkthrough clear; no issues. Conducting sweep on Fort St.
Fort St welfare check complete; no issues to report. KFC, Walker & Hall, Right Track, Jo&Joes vape stores complete; no issues to report. Heading to Gore St.
Gore Street welfare check complete; no issues to report on businesses and properties in the vicinity. Heading to Commercial Bay via Tyler and Commerce St.
Commerce St and Tyler St complete; no issues to report. Conducting sweep on Commercial Bay.
Full sweep on Commercial Bay complete; no issues to report. Welfare check-in on McDonald's Britomart, clear. Heading back up Queen St to conduct welfare check-ins on stores.
Full sweep on lower Queen St complete; Wyndham St clear, no issues to report on local stores in the vicinity. Continuing patrol up Queen St.
Upper Queen St, Elliot, Darby St, Lorne St sweep complete; no issues to report on local businesses. Continuing patrol up Queen St heading to Aotea.
Conducted and completed sweep on Aotea Sq; no issues to report. Heading to Victoria St.
Victoria St sweep complete; no issues to report of the area. Continuing to the Cathedral Church.
Walkthrough Federal St complete; no issues found to report.
Walk around the Cathedral Church clear; no issues to report. Heading to Albert St for welfare checks.
Albert St complete; no issues to report. Welfare check-in on Albert Mart clear. Heading back to HQ to conduct building sweeps.
Building sweep complete; no issues found to report.
All routes complete; no response calls to report, no further issues. Will be standing by in sheltered areas maintaining security presence.
Security presence maintained. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops phone as the battery is on a low percentage.
Standing by at HQ for response calls whilst Ops phone is charging; no further issues.
Ops phone charged; geared up, commencing security presence patrol as well as welfare check-ins with stores still currently open. Heading up Queen St.
Upper Queen St welfare check complete; no issues to report (note: due to weather conditions patrols will again be limited to sheltered areas unless urgent assistance is needed).
Lorne St welfare sweep complete; no issues to report. Heading down Queen St.
Auckland Library sweep clear; no issues.
Walkthrough Aotea Square complete; no issues found to report. Heading back down Queen St.
Full sweep on Queen St complete.
Welfare sweep on Commercial Bay, Fort St, Gore St, Tyler St, Commerce St complete; no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for our 30 minutes.
Afternoon shift complete; no issues to report. Handover to night shift.
Summary of shift: 0 calls to report, 0 issues with stores, 0 issues to report from public. Security presence maintained.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:40 – 06:30)
items: Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu. No issues.
Full sweep Vulcan Lane. All clear, no issues.
Check-in Queen St convenience store. No issues.

Response call to Britomart Maccas due to 2 individuals sleeping inside. We removed the individuals from the premises; no further issues. On standby nearby, keeping an eye out for anyone else causing trouble.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Quay St. All clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Quay St (Providor and AAS); on standby showing security presence.
Welfare check on marina guards. No issues.
Welfare check Albert St convenience store. No issues.
Full sweep Victoria St. All clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Queen St Maccas closed for renovations.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete. Alpha Route complete.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield. No issues. Patrolling down Lorne St heading towards High St; all clear.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St. All clear.
Full sweep Wilson Carpark / Fort St. All clear, no issues.
Check-in Gore St. All clear, no issues.
Patrolling Quay St; all clear, no issues at Providor / AAS.
Welfare check marina guards. No issues.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral church. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep Elliot St / Darby St. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria St. All clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
Break ended; heading back out on patrols.
Check-in Durham St. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St. All clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay. All clear, no issues to report.
Check-in Fort St / Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in Freyberg / Chancery Square. All clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield. All clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops phone and await shift change.
Responded to call from Britomart McDonald's regarding an individual harassing staff.
Arrived at Maccas; POI has left the premises. Had a look around the premises, no one to be found. No further issues; heading back to HQ.
